_comment: Hooks for aspnet-core-plugin. PostToolUse: format the changed C# file with dotnet format (--include scopes it to the changed file). Tries Docker first (service 'app'), falls back to the local dotnet CLI, swallows errors so it never blocks the user.

hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_FILE"; case "$f" in *.cs) docker compose exec -T app dotnet format --include "$f" 2>/dev/null || dotnet format --include "$f" 2>/dev/null; exit 0;; esac
